description: r85 (11-18 8x H100 AWS box, track A, one run per GPU, step-capped at 467 steps with the time stop off so H100 speed does not cut runs short; the lr schedule still reads step s as (s-1)/583 of 17400 s, as on H200). Base is A 007's config (r75: A 006 + 96 prompts/step, cosine 583, stop 467). entropy target 0.15 (from 0.1): more exploration at the same coefficient 0.05. Seeds 0-2, read by final dev against the control. H100 results are not yet gated (H200 is the reference). m30: the same arm with vllm_gpu_memory 0.30 (from 0.35). Three r85 runs ran out of GPU memory on the 80 GB H100 at 0.35 (the trainer was 20-140 MB short of a 3.7 GB allocation); the smaller sampler cache leaves the trainer about 4 GB more and changes speed only, so these seeds are read together with the 0.35 seeds of the same arm. A run that failed at 0.35 continues here from its saved state.
